text:
sam: Quick async standup — onboarding update:
- Did: pushed tiny-quant variant for synthia-v3 and kicked off a 2k-prompt eval sweep.
- Observed: notable quality drop on the "translation-fix" subset (BLEU ~ -7.2).
- Blocker: can't reproduce locally on CPU with the quantized weights; looks like a runtime mismatch when batch=8 on P4d.
- Today: repro on dedicated infra, try kv-cache warmup, open CR for serving config change.

maria: Ugh, saw that subset pop in last night's nightly too. Can you drop the eval artifact link? I want the examples.

sam: sure — artifacts: https://internal.redwood/evals/1719004321/synthia-v3/tinyq-sweep (list + diff table).

lee: I glanced at the diff — many failures are shorter-sequence hallucinations. Might be sequence padding / truncation mismatch with quant kernels. Try forcing seq_len=512 and disable prefix-trim.

olivia: ping me for a quick CR review on the serving flag. If it's just a config toggle I'll take it after lunch. :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: :rocket: Canary deploy started for synthia-v3:tinyq on ded-us-west-2 (canary id c-4823).

sam: repro command I used on canary (ran inside container):
```bash
# repro run (canary)
REDWOOD_MODEL=synthia-v3:tinyq \
REDWOOD_BATCH=8 REDWOOD_SEQ=1024 \
python -m redwood.eval_runner --promptset translation-fix --num=200
```
Result: mismatches only when batch>=6 and kv_cache cold.

maria: FYI I re-ran with caching disabled on canary — results matched expected (no BLEU drop). So likely cache warmup + quant kernel ordering interaction.

lee: I'll schedule a quant-parity job on dedicated nodes tonight (ded-uk). cc @ops-bot for GPU reservation.

ops-bot: reserved 2xA100 on ded-uk for 2h starting 2024-11-14T22:00Z for job: quant-parity-1719004321.

sam: thanks all. opening PR #4823 (serving flag + small kernel fallback) and adding the failing prompt subset to the regression hotlist. Will post final AB numbers here when the dedicated run completes.

olivia: great. tagging docs-owner for a short note if we flip the default.

lee: quick note — if the repro confirms, we might want a short smoke test in the deploy pipeline that runs 50 translation-fix examples with caching warmup.

sam: agreed — adding smoke test to PR. will follow up with timeline.
